loreJson.text: Interlocked courses of fired clay bricks bound with lime mortar, an enduring friend to warm chimneys and sturdy halls.
Sawn boards displaying pale, honest grain, seating flat under the plane and holding nails fast across countless cottages.
Solid, unweathered rock hewn from the planet's deep crust, cracking into rough cobblestone when struck, anchoring all great masonry.
Dressed masonry bricks smelted and carved to true corners, interlocking to form the indestructible backbone of ancient citadels.
